newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Rules on new Belgian small caps market published.
newsitem.headline: Rules on new Belgian small caps market published.

text.p: Rules relating to the Brussels stock exchange's new small capitalisation market, EURO NM Belgium, have been published in the country's official legal gazette, the Bourse said on Wednesday.
The market has been technically operational since the begining of the month.
A Brussels bourse official responsible for the new market, Eric Ronge, said five companies were showing a concrete interest in being quoted on EURO NM Belgium between now and June.

It was probable that the first one would begin trading on the market in March, though the exact timing of each depended on how long the Belgian Banking and Finance Commission took to approve a company's prospectus.

Brussels' new market - or Nouveau Marche - project is part of a wider plan to form a federation of similar markets in Paris, Frankfurt, Amsterdam and Brussels. The Nouveau Marche in Paris is already up and running.
